objective: Execute Phase 15 independent blockbuster world release certification across all quality gates: Gate A (World Catalog), Gate B (Visual & Atmospheric Verification), Gate C (Signature Spectacles), Gate D (Gameplay Regression), Gate E (Graphics Performance Telemetry), Gate F (Quality Presets), Gate G (Resource Lifecycle & Memory), Gate H (Shop & Progression Safety), Gate I (UX & Accessibility), Gate J (Human Playtest Plan), and Final Release Verdict
acceptance_criteria: Ground on clean commit 044f2d4 without assumptions
Gate A: Confirm all 17 registered worlds at runtime with correct ownership, builder execution, scenery, atmosphere, director, train presentation, and cleanup
Gate B: Visually inspect all 17 worlds across checkpoints (0m, 400m, 800m, 1200m, 1600m, 2000m, 3000m), runner camera, landmarks, mobile 390x844, and LOW vs HIGH
Gate C: Audit all Phase 12 & 13 signature spectacles (6-stage contract: approach, anticipation, hero event, reaction, resolution, cleanup) under normal camera and high speed
Gate D: Execute deterministic browser tests for collisions, lane movement, jumps, slides, moving trains, rooftop running, powerups, chaser, revive, retry, and hard mode
Gate E: Capture real empirical frame times (Avg, P50, P95, P99), draw calls, triangles, geometries, textures, and memory on macOS Apple Silicon and Google Chrome
Gate F: Verify HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, and AUTO presets, ensuring LOW retains core world architecture and plinths with zero disappearing worlds
Gate G: Execute 20+ restart and world-switching stress cycles, measuring geometries, textures, event listeners, and detached object pruning
Gate H: Verify coin store purchasing, persistence, unlocked vs locked rules, and character signature worlds
Gate I: Audit mobile portrait UX, keyboard/touch controls, HUD contrast, and reduced motion accessibility
Gate J: Establish rigorous human-playtest task checklist and deliver final independent release category verdict (A, B, or C)
Deliver docs/theme-blockbuster/PHASE15_FINAL_CERTIFICATION.md with all 15 required sections and push to origin/main
non_goals: No new worlds or speculative feature additions
No new gameplay modes or currencies
No major architectural rewrites during release certification
No fabricated hardware benchmarks, self-reported ratings, or invented tester quotes
